headline: GVPO is extended to sequence-level on-policy distillation objectives
summary: An arXiv paper explicitly extends the authors’ NeurIPS 2025 Group Variance Policy Optimization (GVPO) work. Its new bounded contribution is a sequence-level formulation for on-policy distillation (OPD): the authors derive a GVPO loss for matching student and teacher distributions, then generalize it to positive response-weighted teacher/student distributions. The paper proves a consistency result for the transformed objective and shows how group-centering cancels partition-function terms, allowing sampling from the student or previous student policy without importance-sampling correction. The theory is author-reported; this activation did not audit proofs, experiments or code, and does not establish training gains in practice.
